title: On Strike
question: Who will be driving the buses next week?

meanings.usage: 指工人集体停止工作以要求改善条件
表示敲打或攻击的动作
busman的复数形式，指公共汽车司机
表示主动、无偿地提供服务
指自愿提供服务的人
指在某一领域有专业技能的人
形容在某方面很有经验
指痛苦、压力或困难的缓解
表示焦虑或担忧消除后的感觉
对他人帮助或善意的感激之情
指事物的状态或前提要求
指物理压力或心理压力
表示不同意或抗议
指具体的东西或目的
指某事涉及的范围或大小
指涉及大多数人或事物的
指双方达成的共识或合约
指向他人提供帮助或物品
指乘坐交通工具的旅程
表示骑马、骑车或乘车
表示通过考试、地点或时间

examples.en: The workers have decided to go on strike next week.
examples.zh: 工人们决定下周举行罢工。

examples.en: The meeting is due to begin at 9 o'clock.
examples.zh: 会议预定九点开始。

examples.en: To some extent, I agree with you.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的看法。

examples.en: The exam will be held in two days' time.
examples.zh: 考试将在两天后举行。

examples.en: It was cold; even so, we went swimming.
examples.zh: 天气很冷，尽管如此我们还是去游泳了。

examples.en: So far, everything has been smooth.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，一切都很顺利。

examples.en: The government has stated that the policy will not change.
examples.zh: 政府已经声明政策不会改变。

examples.en: I want to express my gratitude to all my teachers.
examples.zh: 我想对所有老师表达我的感激之情。

examples.en: Many people object that young drivers drive too fast.
examples.zh: 许多人反对年轻人开车太快。

examples.en: The company offered free rides to all passengers during the strike.
examples.zh: 罢工期间公司向所有乘客提供免费乘车服务。

sentences.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
sentences.zh: 公交车司机们已决定下周举行罢工。

sentences.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
No one knows how long it will last.
sentences.zh: 没人知道罢工会持续多久。

sentences.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
sentences.zh: 公交车司机们声明，罢工将持续到在工资和工作条件方面达成普遍协议为止。

sentences.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。

sentences.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
sentences.zh: 许多私家车车主将为上班族提供“免费搭车”服务。

sentences.en: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
sentences.zh: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
sentences.zh: 同时，一些大学生已志愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车。

sentences.en: All the students are expert drivers,
sentences.zh: 所有学生都是驾驶专家，

sentences.en: but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
sentences.zh: 但在他们驾驶任何公交车之前，他们必须通过一项特殊的考试。

sentences.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
sentences.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

sentences.en: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
sentences.zh: 即使如此，人们仍然会发现上班很困难。

sentences.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，公众已通过写信给报社的方式表达了对学生的感激之情。

sentences.en: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
sentences.zh: 只有一两个人反对，认为学生们会开得太快！

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：感激，感谢

exercises.hint: 但到目前为止，公众已通过写信给报社的方式表达了对学生的感激之情。
exercises.explain: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press. — 但到目前为止，公众已通过写信给报社的方式表达了对学生的感激之情。

source.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.

exercises.prompt: “表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
options: must have + 过去分词（对过去的肯定推测）
exercises.explain: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)：主语 + have/has + 过去分词：用于描述过去发生但与现在有联系的事件，常与already, yet, just, so far等连用

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
options: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。
有人给我一大笔钱让我搬走，但我决心留在这里。
当我们等待降落时，一位乘务员告诉我们要保持冷静，
他曾常常梦想在英国退休，
exercises.explain: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week. — 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。

source.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.

grammar.title: 将来进行时 (Future Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示将来某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作
grammar.structure: 主语 + will be + 动词-ing
grammar.usage: 用于描述在将来某个具体时间正在发生的动作，或询问他人的计划，语气比 will + 动词原形 更委婉

examples.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
examples.zh: 下周谁将驾驶公共汽车？

examples.en: I will be waiting for you at the station at 8 o'clock tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天八点我会在车站等你。

examples.en: Will you be working late tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚你会工作到很晚吗？

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去发生但与现在有联系的事件，常与already, yet, just, so far等连用

examples.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
examples.zh: 公交车司机已决定下周举行罢工。

examples.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time. They have not taken it yet.
examples.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试，他们还没参加。

grammar.title: be going to 表示将来
grammar.definition: 表示已经计划或决定要做的事，或根据现有迹象判断将要发生的事
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are + going to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 表示人的主观意图、计划或打算，或根据当前情况预测将要发生的事

examples.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people.
examples.zh: 许多私家车主打算向人们提供免费乘车服务。

examples.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
examples.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has decided to + 动词原形

original.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
original.zh: 公交车司机决定下周举行罢工。

examples.en: We have decided to travel abroad this summer.
examples.zh: 我们决定今年夏天去国外旅行。

examples.en: She has decided to quit her job.
examples.zh: 她决定辞职。

original.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
original.zh: 下周谁将驾驶公共汽车？

examples.en: Who will be teaching us English next semester?
examples.zh: 下学期谁教我们英语？

examples.en: Who will be waiting for us at the airport?
examples.zh: 谁会在机场等我们？

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are going to + 动词原形

original.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
original.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

examples.en: I am going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
examples.zh: 我这个周末要去看望祖父母。

examples.en: They are going to open a new restaurant next month.
examples.zh: 他们下个月要开一家新餐厅。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has stated that + 从句

original.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue.
original.zh: 公交车司机已声明罢工将继续进行。

examples.en: The manager has stated that the company will not lay off any employees.
examples.zh: 经理已声明公司不会裁员。

examples.en: The doctor has stated that the patient needs more rest.
examples.zh: 医生已声明病人需要更多休息。
